BiblicalUsage: Chasrah is named once, in the line of Huldah the prophetess: Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe. His name survives because his grandson's wife spoke the word of the LORD to the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a grandfather's name can be kept by his grandson's wife, and a keeper of the wardrobe can stand in the line of a prophetess.
RelatedPeople: Huldah, Prophetess; Shallum, Husband of Huldah
